release_name: Kotlin public announcement at the JVM Language Summit
definition: First public announcement of the language; not the start of development or the 1.0 release.
release_note: JetBrains dates the public announcement to July 19, 2011. Development began in 2010; the first 1.0 release was February 2016.

primary_sources.title: Ten Years of Kotlin!
primary_sources.finding: The official project retrospective dates the JVM Language Summit announcement to July 19, 2011.

primary_sources.title: Kotlin FAQ
primary_sources.finding: The project began in 2010 and version 1.0 was released in February 2016; Kotlin supports static typing, object-oriented and functional programming.

review_method: Official primary pages read with the web service; retained version and JDK release files read without launching any runtime.
